camel_example: aliyun ccc CreateUser --region cn-hangzhou --LoginName yourUserName --Email 'username@example.com' --InstanceId '9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb30000' --RoleId.1 'example-string' --DisplayName '张先生'
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-user --display-name '张先生' --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb30000 --login-name yourUserName --email username@example.com --role-id example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUser

parameters.help_en: The full name of the user
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance in which you want to create the user
parameters.help_zh: 待创建用户的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the user
parameters.name: login_name

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the user
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en:
The email address of the user.

After the user is created, an email is sent to this address. The email contains the Cloud Call Center logon URL, username, and password
parameters.help_zh:
用户电子邮件地址。

新建成功后会发送邮件，邮件中包含呼叫中心登录地址，以及用户名密码
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The PhoneNumberId of the personal outbound number
parameters.name: private_outbound_number_id

parameters.help_en: The role ID of the role to assign to the user
parameters.help_zh: 指定待创建用户的角色，需传入角色ID
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the skill group to which the user is assigned.

SkillGroupId.1 indicates that the user is assigned to only one skill group. To assign the user to multiple skill groups, specify multiple values, such as SkillGroupId.1, SkillGroupId.2, and SkillGroupId.3
parameters.help_zh:
指定待创建用户绑定的技能组ID。

SkillGroupId.1意为只绑定到一个技能组中，如果绑定多个技能组，则需要传多个，例如 SkillGroupId.1、SkillGroupId.2、SkillGroupId.3，以此类推
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill level corresponding to the skill group that the user joins.

SkillLevel.1 indicates the skill level for SkillGroupId.1. If multiple SkillGroupId values are specified, the same number of SkillLevel values must be specified. For more information, see the request examples below
parameters.help_zh:
待创建用户所加入的技能组对应的技能组等级。


SkillLevel.1表示为SkillGroupId.1的技能组等级，如果SkillGroupId为多个，则SkillLevel也需要多个，并且数量需要保持一致，具体请参考下方的请求示例
parameters.name: skill_level

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

UserId.description_en:
The information about the newly created user.

This is the unique identifier of the RAM user in the Cloud Call Center instance, not the RamId. It is a UUID
UserId.description_zh:
新创建的用户信息。


这里是RAM子账号在呼叫中心实例的唯一标识并非RamId，即UUID
